early_exit.reason: No nonvacuous artifact use through TV tau=0.30; tau=0.40 produced only 0.23% nominal gain and a context-level failure.

bfloat16.reason: Slower than FP32 on target CPU.

exact_tail_int8.reason: Tiny gain and context violations in every evaluated split.

hard_per_context_int8.reason: Factor-level envelope held, but raw int8 had prompt-level TV spikes up to 0.2252.

surviving.controller: batch-8 dynamic-int8 probe + conformal residual gate + FP32 subset fallback + factor debt gate

costs.note: One-run total-cost advantage is not established.

verdict.real_result: A proof-carrying statistical microbatch integration is executable and shows a small aggregate runtime gain under a conservative gate, while hard per-context certification and robust total-cost superiority fail.
verdict.next_required: Replicate on independent checkpoints and hardware; replace post-int8 fallback with a pre-execution risk signal or fused exact residual.
